$comment: Exact versions of everything vendored into a build. Committed; the
binaries themselves never are - CI builds them from these pins and
uploads them as artefacts. Changing a pin is a pull request with a
reason, and it re-runs the parity check in docs/adr/spikes/loom-native.md.

loom.note: Head of master on 2026-09-07. The published maps were built from an unpinned master build; the spike checks whether that output matches this commit.

loom_windows_port.note: MSYS2/UCRT64 build scripts and compatibility patches for Windows.

python.note: Upstream publishes no checksum manifest and no per-asset .sha256, so these hashes were computed on first download and are what every later build is checked against. A changed hash means the asset changed, which is the point.
python.licence_check: Verified 2026-09-07: the interpreter links libedit, not GNU readline, and _dbm links only libSystem - no GDBM. Both are GPL components that must stay out; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
